extension.summary: Blurred backgrounds and online ratings for Arctic Fuse 3 without TMDb Helper
extension.description: Makes the blurred and rounded background images Arctic Fuse 3 shows behind its windows and dialogs: the focused item's fanart (cycling its extra fanarts when the skin asks), and the plain background on demand. Runs only while Arctic Fuse 3 is the active skin with blur switched on. With an MDBList and/or OMDb API key in the skin settings it also looks up the focused item's ratings (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd, Trakt, MAL, MDBList); that part is ported from adamsbuilds' script.shortfuse.helper (GPL-3).
